name: AskNeedl
description:
Ask Needl extends Claude with enterprise-grade research and intelligence capabilities, helping teams discover, analyze, and understand complex information from trusted sources.

Ask questions in natural language, research companies and industries, compare entities, summarize documents, uncover insights, and receive grounded, cited answers, all within Claude. Built for enterprise teams, analysts, and knowledge workers, Ask Needl combines intelligent retrieval with conversational reasoning to deliver accurate, explainable responses for research, market intelligence, and decision support.

Currently available by invitation only.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AskNeedl to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AskNeedl to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.needl.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AskNeedl MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AskNeedl provides these MCP tools: ask_needl, get_integration_accounts, list_integrations, and who_am_i.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AskNeedl?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AskNeedl in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
AskNeedl requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AskNeedl is developed by Needl.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
